scientificAssessment.reasoning: NCI identifies surface RTKs, while the EGFR primary abstract supports one asymmetric kinase activation mechanism rather than one universal phosphorylation switch. The retained cutaway has a single common membrane, outside ligands and receptor-attached inner kinase domains. The caption explicitly describes one selected arrangement and separates amount, phosphorylation and growth dependence. The neighboring GPCR and intracellular route remain examples, not a complete taxonomy or an AR/ER identity claim.
